atoms.exact_source_text: A Project has a defined result, a related Role, required materials where appropriate, and committed Citizen time in the Construction Queue.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project has a defined result, a related Role, required materials where appropriate, and committed Citizen time in the Construction Queue.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Project changes a particular Place or creates another specific persistent fact.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project changes a particular Place or creates another specific persistent fact.

atoms.exact_source_text: It never instantly upgrades all Places of the same family.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project never instantly upgrades all Places of the same family.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier advancement, a consequential MEET, a Metropolis relationship, or an explicit world event may create the permission to begin a Project.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tier advancement, a consequential MEET, a Metropolis relationship, or an explicit world event may create the permission to begin a Project.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony must still provide the resources and labor.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony must still provide the resources and labor for a Project even when permission exists.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Place levels up through use, experience points, or a percentage bar.
atoms.normalized_claim: No Place levels up through use, experience points, or a percentage bar.
Place development is selective and authored.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony reaches the appropriate Tier, making Winter Cultivation eligible to be learned.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Winter Garden example, the Colony reaches the appropriate Tier, making Winter Cultivation eligible to be learned.

atoms.exact_source_text: An authored Colony MEET or Rest Stop Metropolis social MEET makes the Practice known directly.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Winter Garden example, an authored Colony MEET or Rest Stop Metropolis social MEET makes the Winter Cultivation Practice known directly.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Gardener Project consumes the required materials and Role time to convert one particular Garden into a winter-capable Garden.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Winter Garden example, a Gardener Project consumes the required materials and Role time to convert one particular Garden into a winter-capable Garden.

atoms.exact_source_text: Only that Place gains the Winter Cultivation Practice.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Winter Garden example, only that particular Place gains the Winter Cultivation Practice.

atoms.exact_source_text: Other Gardens remain unchanged until separately developed.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Winter Garden example, other Gardens remain unchanged until separately developed.
